statusHistory.note: Operator-commissioned (West Hollywood/LA hip-spots war room, 2026-11-04). Verified open and operating via live Google Maps listing (4.4/469 reviews, open hours current as of this session) and claude-in-chrome browser check for exact coordinates. Research floor: near-deep-researcher-equivalent multi-source pass across WEHOonline (the strongest source here — local indie outlet, not a listicle aggregator; logged as a preferred-sources candidate below), TravelGay, Atly, Wanderlog, The Gay Passport, Gathry — six sources consulted, exceeding the five-source floor. Reddit leg: searched twice (site:reddit.com and unfiltered) via web search, no usable r/WeHo or r/WestHollywood threads surfaced on this venue specifically — logged as a floor gap, not fabricated. Google reviews leg: read live via claude-in-chrome rather than web search, since Google review text isn't fetchable through the search backend — recent reviews quoted honestly both ways (an electric-night account three months old; a bartender-upcharge complaint and a separate rudeness complaint about water/straws, both about one month and four months old respectively). No dated event found on this venue's channels this run; none invented. Owner history (Bill Holland's death, the Duarte brothers' 2021 takeover with no planned changes) is real texture from WEHOonline, not decoration. Headline avoids the 'The X that Y' construction and leads with a concrete unique-selling-point (no cover/no dress code) per explicit operator instructions mid-session (2026-11-04) — applies to the rest of this war-room cluster too.

Reciprocal in-text internal link added to/from Bar Lubitsch (bar-lubitsch-weho), the second pin in this same war-room cluster, now that it exists — resolves the internal-link gap logged at first publish rather than leaving it open with a sibling now available. All six locales trimmed to stay at or under the 250-word hero-only image floor after the addition.
